14-18.solution: The three true numbers sum to \(480\) but \(530\) was used, so the true total is \(25 \times 175 - 50 = 4325\) and the average \(\frac{4325}{25} = 173\).

14-51.solution: The replacements add \((32 + 35 + 39) - (26 + 29 + 31) = 20\) to the total, so the average rises by \(\frac{20}{24}\): \(37 + 0.83 = 37.83\).
